address: 6F, Hilton Nanjing Niushoushan, 8 Ningdan Avenue, Jiangning, Nanjing, Chinese Mainland
bio: Opened in 2023, the interior is inspired by nature and splashes of green resonate with the nearby forest park. The executive chef, who hails from Yancheng, deploys his solid skills to finesse creative Huaiyang fare that highlights natural flavours. His Nanjing roast duck is steeped in a spiced soy marinade for 8 hours, before being air-dried and grilled to perfection. His deboned fish head in five-flavour sauce is equally popular.
